skill.name: webask-answer-notifications
skill.description: Настраивает и чинит уведомления о новых ответах на опрос WebAsk — письма получателям, сообщения в Telegram и MAX. Применяется, когда человек хочет получать ответы на почту, добавить получателя или разобраться, почему уведомления перестали приходить.
skill.summary: Configure and troubleshoot WebAsk response notifications through email, Telegram, and MAX.
skill.author: webaskio

finding_verdicts.reason: README.md:1 uses parent-directory paths in HTML breadcrumb links to repository documentation. These are navigation links, not filesystem operations accepting untrusted paths.
The backticks format get_quiz_email_settings as inline Markdown while describing inspection of notification settings. No shell or Ruby execution is present.
The backticks mark the get_quiz_integrations tool name in documentation about integration status and plan restrictions. This is not an executable shell expression.
add_quiz_email_recipient is an inline Markdown tool reference, not shell execution. The surrounding workflow requires address verification and explicitly forbids adding unspecified addresses.
confirm_quiz_email_recipient is formatted as a tool name in the address-verification workflow. The prose requires a confirmation code and contains no shell execution.
toggle_quiz_email is a Markdown-formatted tool reference for managing survey email notifications. The skill requires asking before enabling intentionally disabled notifications.
toggle_quiz_email_recipient is inline Markdown documenting recipient-level notification controls. The backticks do not invoke a shell interpreter.
set_quiz_email_questions is a Markdown tool reference for selecting questions included in notifications. No command execution or arbitrary evaluation is shown.
save_quiz_email_template appears as inline Markdown in a description of email template editing. There is no executable shell or Ruby code.
manage_quiz_messenger names the documented MCP tool for messenger notification settings and testing. Its Markdown delimiters do not execute commands.
The backticked word test names a messenger tool action for checking delivery. It is a documented action value, not shell command substitution.
get_quiz_integrations is an inline Markdown reference in a troubleshooting checklist. It describes checking integration status, not invoking a shell.
get_integration_logs is a Markdown-formatted tool name for reading messenger delivery failures. The line does not execute log contents or shell commands.
resend_integration_logs is a documented tool reference for retrying deliveries after resolving their cause. The surrounding instructions prohibit premature retries; no shell execution appears.

content.value_statement: Missed survey notifications can leave teams unaware of new responses. This skill guides assistants through WebAsk notification setup, recipient verification, and delivery troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Inspect survey email settings, notification recipients, messenger integrations, and plan restrictions through WebAsk MCP tools.
Add user-specified email recipients and confirm their addresses using verification codes.
Enable or disable survey email notifications and individual recipients, respecting intentionally disabled settings.
Select questions for email notifications and save email templates.
Manage Telegram and MAX notification settings, choose included questions, and send test messages.
Inspect messenger delivery logs and retry accumulated deliveries after resolving the failure.
limitations: Requires access to the external WebAsk MCP tools listed by the skill; their implementations are not included.
Email delivery cannot begin until the recipient address is confirmed.
Connecting a messenger bot to a chat requires manual setup in the WebAsk account.
Cannot bypass plan restrictions, restore revoked tokens automatically, or guarantee message delivery.

use_cases.title: Route new leads to sales
use_cases.description: Configure email recipients and include contact details with selected survey answers in each notification.

use_cases.title: Monitor campaign responses in chat
use_cases.description: Configure an already connected Telegram or MAX integration and check delivery with a test message.

use_cases.title: Investigate missing notifications
use_cases.description: Check recipient confirmation, integration status, and messenger logs before retrying failed deliveries.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect notification settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current email, Telegram, and MAX notification settings for survey [survey ID]. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Add an email recipient
prompt_templates.prompt: Add [email address] as a notification recipient for survey [survey ID]. Guide me through address confirmation. Leave all other recipients unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a messenger notification
prompt_templates.prompt: For survey [survey ID], check the connected [Telegram or MAX] chat. Include only [question IDs] and send one test message after confirming the destination.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: configure and test a connected messenger.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose and recover delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate missing notifications for survey [survey ID]. Review settings, recipient verification, plan restrictions, and messenger logs. Propose fixes and request approval before changes or retries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: diagnose failures and control recovery actions.

output_examples.input: Example request: Check Telegram and MAX notification availability.
output: Example status: The Telegram test message succeeded.

output_examples.input: Example request: Diagnose failed Telegram deliveries without making changes.
output: Example log result: The bot was removed from the group.

best_practices: Inspect existing settings before editing, and ask before enabling notifications that someone intentionally disabled.
Use only explicitly supplied recipient addresses and confirm them before expecting email delivery.
Confirm messenger destinations before testing, and resolve delivery failures before retrying accumulated messages.
anti_patterns: Adding guessed addresses or sending survey responses to recipients the user did not specify.
Retrying failed deliveries before correcting the underlying integration problem.
Including every survey answer when only a few relevant fields are needed.

faq.question: Which notification channels does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers WebAsk survey response notifications through email, Telegram, and MAX.

faq.question: Why does an added email address still receive nothing?
faq.answer: The address must be confirmed using the emailed code. Also check whether survey email and the individual recipient are enabled.

faq.question: Can the assistant connect a messenger bot to a chat?
faq.answer: No. Bot connection requires manual setup in the WebAsk account because messenger login is needed.

faq.question: Can I test messenger delivery without a new survey response?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented messenger tool supports a test action for checking notification delivery.

faq.question: What happens when the current plan blocks an integration?
faq.answer: The skill directs the assistant to report the restriction and stop. It does not recommend an upgrade or initiate payment.

faq.question: What must be available before using this skill?
faq.answer: Your assistant needs access to the listed WebAsk MCP tools and the relevant survey. This package provides instructions, not the tool implementations.
